correctness.rationale: Exact edge-set overlap yields C=nu(I+rA) with A the J(n,3) adjacency matrix. The covariance is positive definite because distinct triangle indicators are distinct multilinear monomials on a full-support Boolean cube. Permutation symmetry reduces the inverse to four distance classes, direct Johnson neighbor counts yield a four-equation system, and its explicit solution gives the claimed coefficients. Delta, Q, and B are strictly positive for all n>=6 and 0<p<1, so all precision and linear partial-correlation signs follow.

value.rationale: Triangle indicators are the primitive motif variables whose sum is the classical triangle count. The theorem gives their complete finite precision geometry and shows that sparse marginal dependence hides a nonlocal alternating pattern after linear adjustment. The sign classification by edge-sharing, vertex-sharing, and disjointness is natural, exact, and interpretable.
